finding: The workflow's intended PR checkout path is not demonstrated by retained independent evidence. Every retained executed agent workload is a no-PR schedule control; all 26 recorded PR-checkout steps were skipped.

reviewedInputs: Every first-parent workflow/compiled lock/native-checker change through the frozen revision
Original and frozen transitive checker dependencies
Protected runner invocation, setup copying, and event-info artifact producer
No-PR skip and closed/deleted-PR warning paths
Strict versus historical coercing dispatch parser
Fork, centralized router and collaborator/bot trust policy eras
sourceReview.importantDistinction: A compiled checkout_pr_success output can be true when there was no PR context or a closed PR could not be checked out. A non-main branch alone cannot establish the intended SHA, initialized/clean state, origin or visible history.

compiledPolicyVariants.sourceBindingRequirement: The protected actions-folder checkout names github/gh-aw without an explicit ref. A run's head SHA and a mainline checker blob therefore do not by themselves identify the loaded runtime checker. Acceptance additionally requires independent loaded-actions/script/dependency identity. Setup copies those scripts into runner.temp before the PR checkout; no source profile is claimed as execution proof.

completeAcquisition.scope: All retained initial Actions invocations for this workflow from adoption through the exclusive cutoff, with all event classes and all branches.
completeAcquisition.reruns: Latest attempt is retained as metadata. Only attempt 1 jobs are inspected; run-level artifacts are discovery only and never assumed to belong to attempt 1.
completeAcquisition.artifactDisposition: All artifact names are existing usage, safe-output, detection, agent, fallback, info or AIC-scan machinery. No independent protected checkout-conjunction producer exists in the source. Their existence does not prove a PR checkout. The info producer preserves selected context but not complete original event/expected head/clean workspace facts.
completeAcquisition.logDisposition: No initial protected checkout step executed, so no protected positive checkout log was produced. Successful schedule-agent logs and self-authored output are not substituted for this missing path.
completeAcquisition.completenessLimit: Complete retained Actions inventory is not complete historical event or eligible-opportunity evidence. Deleted runs/events and absent original webhook payloads cannot be reconstructed from this inventory.

evaluation.baseline: The same Git checkout outcome existed before adoption, but immutable source cannot reconstruct the original event, contemporaneous PR head or historical runner worktree. No zero baseline is invented.
evaluation.plot: Native-unit gap plot, not a measured value or zero-value series.

validation.collector: verify-value-function.mjs --collector: passed against actual retained acquisition
validation.lint: ESLint on owned scripts and function: passed; repository intentionally ignores tests
validation.compile: npm run compile: 72 workflows succeeded, 2 pre-existing action-version warnings
validation.failClosed: Actual replay fails when observations disappear or index population changes. All 256 original source blobs independently verify as native Git objects.

registration.readinessGuard: Remain blocked unless index.measurementReady is true and replayed current native evidence has a non-null primary value with the required event/source/head/workspace receipts. Inventory completion, a generated plot, or synthetic validation examples do not satisfy readiness.

openRequirements: A protected, source-bound original event/dispatch receipt that proves PR identity, trigger class and policy admission.
An independent contemporaneous expected head SHA/ref, including PR advancement/fetch races.
Protected pre-agent actual HEAD, branch, clean status, initialized Git state, origin and visible-history readback.

Historical source-policy coherence for any proposed receipt, including fork/bot/router and closed-PR behavior; independently bind the actually loaded actions checkout because its source ref is not explicitly pinned.
A complete eligible-opportunity denominator before claiming a complete total or trend.
reusableSkillLessons: Enumerate all trigger classes before scoring; successful no-op schedules cannot verify a PR-specific path.
A success-shaped checkout output may deliberately cover skip and closed-object paths. Read every conditional return.
Preserve expected and actual Git identities independently; a branch name or HEAD export does not prove clean checkout.
Historical dispatch number parsing can change eligibility. Preserve coercing and strict parser eras rather than applying today's parser retroactively.
A fully exhausted execution inventory can still leave every native outcome unknown. Do not count an all-gap plot as measured coverage.
Inspect source-defined artifact producers before downloading agent payloads; machinery artifacts cannot supply an absent protected assertion.
A checkout of an actions repository without an explicit ref need not load scripts from the workflow run head. Require the actual loaded source identity, not a convenient revision assumption.
